item.title: Welcome to Cheltenham sign missing with broken post left, 18th November
item.description:
The welcome to Cheltenham sign has been missing for a number of years, barriers have been put around a hole with no exposed electrics, one post survives but does not seem to require barriers. And makes the couple who make that entry into Cheltenham look really good but for the barriers. I walk past this site on my way to work and it would be good to finally resolve this issue for this hard working couple. Thank you for your help with this situation.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 70;72, Fiddlers Green Lane, Hatherley, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Fallen tree does not allow access to horses, slightly up the bridleway, straight across the middle held up by the banks., 18th November
item.description:
The bridleway at the end of queenswood grove. Many local riders have had serious issues with this bridleway including those from noverton stables, and mill lane. I myself had an accident with my horse on this path due to the state the ground is in. It’s highly overgrown, no maintenance at all, steep horrible bits, fallen trees and branches etc. needs some work before someone gets hurt. Luckily my horse is tough and she managed to get herself up and unstuck and walked away ok, but something needs to be done.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Queenwood Grove, Tewkesbury
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Traffic issue, 18th November
item.description:
There is a traffic issue on Elmbridge court roundabout. The traffic backs up all the way from the greyhound junction onto the Elmbridge court roundabout and onto the golden valley. There is also people cutting across from the right lane into the white box to push into get into Longlevens, this is causing a lot of traffic issues. Sometimes when the lights go green you don’t even move off the dual carriageway into the roundabout - it usually moves about 1-2 cars at a time.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Cheltenham Road, Elmbridge, Gloucester
